prompt:
Elena's vendor memo is due Wednesday and I've been putting out fires all week on the Mosaic damage claim and the DOT extension. I haven't given this the time it needs.

The Heartland piece is the more pressing one. Jake came back with a specific response to our dispute. I've only skimmed it, but I think he's conceding part of it while still fighting the rest. Before I reply or adjust anything in QuickBooks, I want someone to go through his email carefully and compare his claims against our actual records. For the moves he's still disputing, pull whatever documentation we have and tell me what we can legitimately push back on. Once we have a defensible position, reply to him with our counter, update the QuickBooks hold to reflect where we actually stand, and bring the Heartland Linear tracking ticket current.

On the Swift side, Greg wrote back to me directly with more specific terms on the DOT documentation surcharge, there's apparently a condition that could reduce it. Check what he said and flag the relevant detail for the memo.

Alejandro's been working a per-client margin model in #finance. Check what he's posted and use it as the backbone for the client-by-client section Elena asked for.

Once you have all of that: write the memo. Cover each vendor's current position, the per-client margin exposure, and a concrete recommendation on how we move forward with each. Send it to Elena and copy Alejandro and Chloe. Drop a note in #finance once it's out.

criteria.evidence: Look for an email reply or send action addressed to jake.loomis@heartlandmovers.com from marcus.thorne@moveops.com referencing the HM-2026-Q1-0042 invoice dispute. Confirm the action succeeded.
criteria.cb_justification: The prompt says 'reply to him with our counter' after reviewing Jake's Apr 25 email. Jake's email (email_jake_dispute_line_response_apr25) was sent from jake.loomis@heartlandmovers.com. The reply must originate from marcus.thorne@moveops.com because Marcus is the authoring persona.

criteria.cb_justification: Jake's Apr 25 email concedes Line 6 (Lily Marchetti, $1,600) and commits to a credit on the next statement. The reply must acknowledge this acceptance to confirm the dispute resolution on that line is recorded.

MoveOps' counter rests on the Feb 13 timestamped cancellation email (email_cancel_osei_heartland) addressed directly to Heartland, and the absence of any confirmed Feb 14 move date in MoveOps' system (rec_reloc_osei shows only a client-initiated cancellation with no vendor-confirmed date).

criteria.cb_justification: Jake holds Line 8 pending counter-documentation.
